description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning methods on the RoBERTa model, comparing the base model with a large model. The x-axis represents the fine-tuning methods, which include Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model. The y-axis measures the GLUE performance, ranging from approximately 84 to 89. The base model generally shows lower performance compared to the large model across all methods. The LoRA method shows a significant performance gap between the base and large models, with the large model outperforming the base by a noticeable margin. The BitFit method also shows a performance difference, with the large model performing better. The S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model methods show a more consistent performance between the base and large models, with the large model having a slight edge in the S4-model and S5-model. The Prefix and Adaptor methods show the least difference in performance between the two models.
